# FNB-ETAF reporting and evidence guidance

- Preserve report accuracy: passed, failed, skipped, soft-asserted, scenario, feature, duration, screenshot, video, download, and evidence information must remain correctly associated.
- Do not mark a failed action as passed or replace the original failure reason with generic reporting text.
- Preserve existing Extent, HTML, PDF, per-feature, JMeter/performance, and UI-performance artifact behaviors unless a coordinated reporting change is explicitly approved.
- Keep timings readable while retaining raw values when needed for analysis.
- Do not put sensitive values or internal application details into report messages, filenames, generated HTML, PDFs, JSON, or CSV output.
